a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan means we'll almost certainly both still hold 0 cells when the storm hits. So I'm proposing we drop it, and I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you'd rather we split some other way, say so and I'll listen.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
